General Contracting

How long does a typical project take? Small repairs: 1–5 days. Larger remodels or additions: 2–6 weeks. We provide clear, realistic timelines upfront.

Do you handle insurance work? Yes. We work directly with adjusters and ensure proper documentation.

Do you pull permits? Yes, we handle all permitting and inspections for compliant work.

What if my project changes mid-way? We document changes in writing and adjust the scope and timeline accordingly.

How do you ensure quality across trades? We use trusted local partners and supervise all work on site.

Home Renovations

How long do renovations typically take? Kitchen or bath projects often take 3–7 weeks depending on scope and material lead times. Whole-home work typically takes 4–12 weeks. We provide clear, realistic timelines upfront.

Do you work with older homes? Yes. Many of our projects are in homes built 30–60+ years ago. We’re experienced with the surprises that come with them.

Will I need to move out? Usually not for kitchen or bath work. We work around your schedule as much as possible.

What warranty do you offer? We provide a one-year workmanship warranty, plus manufacturer warranties on materials and appliances.

Kitchen & Bath Remodeling

How long do kitchen or bath projects take? Typically 3–6 weeks for a standard remodel, depending on scope and material lead times. We provide clear, realistic timelines upfront.

Can I live in the home during the work? Yes for most projects. We contain dust and work around your schedule.

Do you help with design? We guide selections and can recommend partners for full design if needed.

Can I choose my own materials? Yes. We can source or install owner-provided materials with our standard workmanship warranty.

Outdoor Living

How long does an outdoor project take? Most decks and patios are completed in 1–3 weeks depending on size and weather. We provide clear, realistic timelines upfront.

What materials hold up well in Texas? We recommend composite decking, treated lumber, and properly sealed concrete for longevity.

Do you handle drainage issues? Yes. We assess and improve grading and drainage as part of the project.

Is a permit needed? Often yes for larger structures. We manage the permitting process.

Fencing, Concrete & Repairs

How long for a fence or patio? Fencing: 3–10 days. Patios/concrete: 2–5 days for most jobs. We provide clear, realistic timelines upfront.

Do you do concrete repairs too? Yes—cracks, leveling, resurfacing, and full replacement.

What fencing materials do you recommend? We offer wood, vinyl, metal, and ranch fencing suited to Texas conditions and aesthetics.

Is there a warranty on fencing and concrete? Yes, we provide workmanship warranties in addition to manufacturer guarantees.

Custom Homes

How long does a custom home take? Typically 9–18 months from start to finish, depending on size, complexity, and material availability. We provide clear, realistic timelines upfront.

Can you build on my lot? Yes. We evaluate soil, drainage, and access during planning.

Do you offer design services? We work with your architect or can recommend trusted designers.

Do you build energy-efficient homes? Yes. We incorporate insulation, windows, and systems to reduce long-term energy costs.

Still have questions? Get in touch or call us at (254) 581-3808. We're happy to help.
